The placement matches the sibling `foo_extensions` schedules.

nit: `prepare_profile` does `get_required_var('FOO_PROFILE')`, and this schedule is not aarch64-specific. Which scenarios use it, and do they all already set FOO_PROFILE in the job group? If a job-group change is needed, please link it, and add a VR for each arch that uses this schedule.

nit: the commit body repeats the title; it would help to say why the module has to run before the network setup, since that is what anyone reading the schedule later will ask about.
